spans.text: Thesite has been discovered on many planets across the universe due to chunks of the Cosmic Teardrops breaking off during their journeys through space. The reality-warping power of thesite has resulted in many interpretations as to its nature: on Somnus Domina, it was used first and foremost as a miraculous means to create weapons to fight the Grand Primaries, for example, and later used to construct the first DGRs. In some places, fanatics have taken to worshipping the material.

The Crystal Collective is an exolunar group who emerged from an unknown planet, using the powers of a massive thesite deposit they had access to to reach space earlier than expected. They are technologically advanced due to their use of it, but treat the material as though it was divine.

The Collective believes thesite was thrust into the mortal world to test all mortal life by seeing what they could accomplish with it... and they are determined to be the ones to pass. They broadly feel that thesite can be used to elevate a creature beyond their physical body or soul as others know them, and so experiment with grafting it onto themselves or exposing living creatures to it to cause changes. In some cases they have found success, but in others have created monstrosities or incited tragedy.

These fanatics operate with cold, calculating indifference. They will sometimes use planets or settlements as quiet testing grounds for their experiments, and are willing to sacrifice life on any scale to push their knowledge of thesite forward. They are mostly godless, and believe no deity could have the perspective needed for their mission.

The Collective has a limited amount of thesite, and is largely unwilling to break apart the “Mother Stone” - the huge deposit their culture is based around, which they fiercely guard. So, to gain more material to test, they travel the universe looking for sources of thesite to steal and experiment with, even if it has been molded into another form already.

Collective agents will commonly be found in other fields of scientific discovery. They will blend into other groups of researchers or help particular scientific missions advance so they can benefit from their discoveries, or use them for the Collective’s own goals. It is not uncommon for a well-adjusted researcher to have a horrific secret lab squirreled away for their private use, hidden from public eyes.
